decision_vocabulary.NATIVE_WRAPPED: Claude Code supplies the runtime primitive; D-024 adds durable state, policy, verification, or recovery
decision_vocabulary.CUSTOM_REQUIRED: no sufficient native capability exists (includes governance/process rows enforced by project-control machinery)
decision_vocabulary.OPTIONAL_ENHANCEMENT: useful but not required for loop activation
decision_vocabulary.REJECTED_OR_DEFERRED: inappropriate, experimental, unsafe, or contrary to project policy (for the stated use)
decision_vocabulary.NATIVE_REPLACEMENT: native provides the behavior outright; none assigned - every native adoption here still needs D-024 durable state/policy/verification, so the honest maximum is NATIVE_WRAPPED
